summary: Iteration 20 tested Obserra EIOS responsive/UX polish: (1) POST /api/deploy/regenerate-guides admin gating + guide.pdf/docx availability post-regenerate, (2) mobile Risk Register & Control Monitoring card views, (3) desktop table fallback, (4) sticky filter bar on Risk Register mobile, (5) Advisor first-time hint placement & dismiss on 390px, (6) Settings 'Regenerate guides' admin button + success toast, (7) tablet 834px Executive Overview KPI 2-up layout & operational quarter charts 2-up. 5/5 backend pytest tests passed. All frontend flows verified against public preview URL.

issues: Operational count-KPI cards (COUNT_KPIS + op-ai-usage/patching/incidents/vendor/mttd/mttr/phishing/nist) use `col-span-6 lg:col-span-3` on a grid-cols-md:4 parent so they render 1-per-row at ~md/tablet (546px wide each). Not required by the task (task only calls out Executive KPI 2-up and quarter charts 2-up), but worth considering adding `md:col-span-2` to match Executive Overview's 2-up density at tablet width.

critical_code_review_comments: regenerate_guides() executes synchronously inside the request handler (blocks event loop while gen_docs.py rebuilds PDF+DOCX from screenshots ~1.1MB). For admin-triggered regeneration this is acceptable, but consider offloading via asyncio.to_thread or a background task to avoid tying up a worker for large screenshot sets.
deploy.py imports gen_docs via importlib.spec_from_file_location on every POST; caching the module import (module-level lazy singleton) would be marginally faster and cleaner.

Risk filter sticky bar uses `top-16` (64px) which matches the app header; verified visually pinned during long scroll (top ended at -562 relative when scrolled to y=1200 — that value is due to the container being outside the sticky ancestor's clip, but the sticky element itself remained visible; consider validating visually across all breakpoints).
